name: Tenqual
description:
Tenqual monitors procurement sources worldwide, qualifies the notices that match your scope, and sends the source data and available tender documents to your inbox, CRM, API, or AI agent

Through this connector, Claude can search live tender notices, check qualified matches for your workspace, review alert definitions, and pull tender documents directly into your workflow, so you can act on relevant opportunities without manually scanning multiple portals

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tenqual to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tenqual to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.tenqual.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tenqual MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tenqual lists 22 MCP tools, including tenqual_create_alert, tenqual_delete_alert, tenqual_disable_webhook, tenqual_draft_alert, tenqual_estimate_alert, tenqual_get_alert_draft, tenqual_get_connection, tenqual_get_document_resource, tenqual_get_tender, tenqual_get_tender_documents, tenqual_get_usage, and tenqual_list_alerts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tenqual?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tenqual in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Tenqual requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tenqual is developed by Tenqual. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
